column1: # THE PHYSICAL C-SOURCE CAUSAL EXPERIMENT FOR SITE-A64-CC-FOR.
COMPILER_PRODUCER_ID_AND_SHA256=the production selector-ON compiler, built by the canonical Makefile from the mutated worktree; linked executable sha256 below
G0_SELECTOR_CONFIGURATION_AND_PROOF=the canonical production configuration: HCC_USE_SELFHOST_* all ON, the compiler is the REAL production ./hcc built by 'make all'
WITNESS_PRISTINE_SEMANTIC_OBSERVATION=W-A64-CC-FOR: cset x0, lt ; program output LT_OK ; exit 0
WITNESS_MUTATED_SEMANTIC_OBSERVATION=W-A64-CC-FOR: cset x0, ge ; program output LT_BAD ; exit 0

ADJACENT_SITE_CONTROL_OUTCOMES=W-A64-CC-INV UNCHANGED (b.ge, LT_OK); W-A64-CSET CHANGED (cset x0, ge, CMP_BAD) -- the CSET witness shares the aarch64CcFor table and is therefore NOT an isolation control for this site; the ISOLATION control for this site is W-A64-CC-INV
